correctness.rationale: The exact relation F_kα=F_{k−2}+(−1)^k r^k and r²=1−r produces the single-block three-gap successor cycle (modular addition by F_{k−2}, gcd(F_{k−2},F_k)=1). For even k the second block is translated +2r^k; odd k reduces by circle reflection. The explicit insertions into each short/medium/long initial gap partition it into five possible lengths; multiplicities sum to 2F_k+2. For the Sturmian partition the length-n cylinders have the n+1 rotation endpoints. Since all marginal arcs are shorter than 1/2, a nonempty intersection of two arcs is connected and each joint word labels a single refined interval; thus joint entropy equals the five-gap entropy, no multiplicity collapse. Binet limits give I=log F_k+C+o(1), matching independently recomputed C. Independently high-precision Decimal-90 exhaustive gaps across k=6..14 match both histograms exactly within 10^-68, but all-order proof depends on the exact insertion/successor argument.
